notes: no free-cast card choice appeared within 180s of accepting the may

protocol-142 driver (v0.110.0): mechanical port of the verified protocol-120 scenario_6764_01050.py. Knowledge Pool cast via bare legacy CastSpell matched by object_id, engine auto-pays (payment_mode Auto); the driver never taps lands for mana itself (no double-payment artifact). Shock casts via CastSpell with {R:1}; Shock targets via the advertised vi target opportunity (schema select/sequence), seat-1 candidate preferred; may-choice via exactChoices decideOptionalEffect accept true/false; the free-cast card choice found by scanning vi opportunities for card-object candidates (hand-zone-only prompts excluded); free cast submitted as {type:<spec.type>, data:{choiceIds:[...]}}; free_cast_window flag marks the card-choice-to-resolution window (driver makes no mana payments at all, so any mana demand by the engine would surface as a stall rather than being silently paid).

Cast-confirmation guard (AGENTS.md 2026-10-09): after every CastSpell submission the driver withholds priority and starts no new main-phase plays until the cast is confirmed (spell left the hand / on the stack); *_cast flags are set at confirmation, not submission; 30s backstop treats a still-in-hand cast as dropped and re-arms the cast block. The free-cast choice (a viewer interaction, not a legacy CastSpell) gets a progress watcher with no priority hold.

P0 deck 4x Knowledge Pool + 24x Shock + 32x Mountain; P1 60x Island draw-go, never attacks or blocks (engine accepts >4-of for custom games). Leg 1 (decline) exiles Shock #1, making it part of the legal free-cast set on leg 2 alongside the 6 imprint cards.

Isolated server: this run started its own backfill-owned v0.110.0 server on 127.0.0.1:9374 (games.db + server.log under runs/run-6764-reval-v01100-20261015-1111/) after verifying the release identity; the previously running shared server (PID 1482, log under /runs/) vanished in a mid-task VM replacement.
